game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the forge smith's power beats the shield shown by ash wraiths.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the forge smith's power beats the shield shown by ash wraiths. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about power to power up the forge smith and open the lava bridge.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Eruption Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Eruption Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
